g.text: JST: J2 is 3-pin JST (GND, DATA, 5V). Use JST-XH/PH/SM as preferred; match connectors on LED panel. Optional: DS3231 RTC, LDR+10K, level shifter.
Corner touch pads omitted. Verify ESP32 pin mapping in Fritzing before soldering.
Wiring: Buck 5V/GND -> C1 1000uF + J2 JST(5V,GND). ESP32 GPIO27 -> R1 470R -> J2 DATA -> LED chain DIN/DOUT serpentine. All LED 5V/GND must
be connected to 5V rail (shown sampled every 22 LEDs for readability; connect all in build). Add power injection wires at row ends.
60cm wordclock COMPLETE SKETCH: 224 WS2812B (110 letters x2 + 4 corners). PCB: TwoLayerRectangle 380x390mm, LEDs placed at real 60cm
well/corner coords. Controller: perfboard in 200x100mm cavity. ESP32 on female headers. 5V 10A barrel -> buck 5.0V.
